correctness.rationale: For each prescribed collection of distinct sites, the fixed-count probability is (a)_u(b)_(r-u)/(n)_r. The only compatible overlap shifts for 000 and 001 are +1 and +2; disjoint placements have five zeros and one one. The exact first and mixed moments yield the displayed rational covariance, checked by independent symbolic cancellation and 79723 finite rational assertions. A factor-sign argument proves the strict threshold. If equality holds, 2n-3 divides 15, giving only n=4,9, with a=3,4. Direct enumeration handles n=4,5; hence all integer domains are covered. Bounded enumeration alone is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Under the natural fixed-composition binary-pattern null, 000 counts the total length in excess of two across all zero runs, while 001 counts zero runs of length at least two that exit into a one. Their joint covariance determines whether these two motif signals reinforce or compete when calibrating a contrast. The exact all-size sign cutoff, its O(1) finite-size offset from n/4, and the complete arithmetic classification of nondegenerate zero cases are not mere normalizations or a single small-n computation. The theorem does not claim new test power or a complete joint distribution.
